row.text:
Once upon a time, there was a snowman. His name was Bob. He lived in a cold, snow-covered town.

The townspeople were always looking for Bob. They wanted him to play with them.

One day, Bob saw some children playing in the snow. He wanted to join in. He quickly got ready to play.

But then, something strange happened. A gust of wind blew the snow away! Bob had to hurry to catch up with the children. He ran as fast as he could. But the wind blew faster than Bob.

The townspeople were sad. They were jealous of the wind for taking Bob away. It was too late; Bob was gone.

But when the snow came back, so did Bob! The townspeople were so happy! They hugged and cheered.

Bob had come back! They all played together in the snow. Hurray!

It was a bright, sunny day, and Jack wanted to have some fun. He ran to the park, and saw a big slide. He quickly ran to the top of it and slid all the way down. He felt so happy and giddy that he laughed out loud.

Jack noticed a rubber stamp lying nearby and he picked it up. He looked for something to stamp and soon found a piece of paper. He stamped the paper and smiled. "I made a nice stamp!" he thought.

Suddenly, he heard a noise and looked up to see two dead birds lying on the ground. He felt sad and wondered why the birds couldn't fly around with him. He wanted to help them, but he knew he couldn't. So he said a small prayer and ran off to find something else to do.

Once upon a time, there was a small village. It was not big and fancy, but it was a very modest place. Everyone in the village was happy.

One day, a little girl called Jenny wanted to explore the village. She was looking for something exciting to do. She decided to go for a dive in the river.

So, Jenny put on her swimming suit and ran to the river. She jumped in, and felt the refreshing water. It was so fun to dive in the river! She swam around and did somersaults underwater.

When she got tired, Jenny went up to the surface to rest. She pulled herself onto the riverbank, and waved hello to a duck that was swimming in the river.

Jenny had lots of fun that day, and she told all her friends in the village about her dive. She was looking forward to her next dive in the river.

Once upon a time, there were two best friends. Their names were Sally and Jack. One day, Sally mentioned to Jack that she wanted to make something special. She said that she wanted to make something out of glue.

Jack got an idea and showed Sally to a popular store. They went inside and saw a lot of glue and a lot of fun things to make. Sally's eyes lit up and she started to pick out all the materials she wanted.

Sally and Jack went home and spent the afternoon making something special. Sally used the glue to stick things together. They had a lot of fun and made some really cool things. 

When it was finished, Sally and Jack were so proud of it. They both hugged each other and were very pleased with the result. They were the best of friends and were never scared to mention anything to each other.

Once, there was a person who felt very careless. One day, they decided to do something daring. So they decided to climb a tall tree! But as they were climbing, they were not careful. They slipped and their hand got stuck on a nail. The person felt very scared and cried very loud. The other people around them could hear and came to help. They got the person down and out from the nail. Everyone was relieved and happy that the person was safe. From then on, the person remembered to be more careful when climbing and to never be too careless again!

Once there was a little girl named Alison. Alison lived with her mom and dad. She loved to dress up in new clothes every day. No matter what she was wearing, she always felt cool.

One day Alison's mom brought her a new dress. It was pretty and sparkly! Alison was so excited that she put it on right away. She asked her mom to take her outside to show off her new dress.

Outside in the front yard, Alison was playing in her dress when it started to rain. Alison shouted out to her mom, but the rain was so loud she couldn't hear. Alison started to run inside, but she was so spoiled that she didn't want to get wet.

So instead of running inside, Alison hid under a cooler. She stayed there until the rain stopped. When the sun came out, she was still dry and could play in her dress again. So Alison removed the cooler, spun around and laughed as she enjoyed her new dress in the sun.

Once there was a girl named Jane. Jane was three years old and she wanted to go on an adventure. She wanted to go to a magical place where everything was beautiful.

So one day, Jane decided to go. She put some makeup on and smiled as she looked in the mirror. She was ready to go.

Jane stepped outside and it was very rough. The wind was blowing and the clouds were everywhere. It seemed like an impossible journey, but Jane was determined.

She closed her eyes, took a deep breath and prayed. She asked for courage and strength. She prayed for help and protection.

Suddenly the sky cleared and Jane saw a rainbow in the sky. She knew that she had been heard. She smiled and knew that her adventure was about to begin.

Once upon a time, there was a girl who wanted to swim. She had an ordinary helmet and it was bright red. She put the helmet on her head, smiled and jumped into the pool.

The water was cool and felt very nice. She practiced her swimming strokes and quickly became a very good swimmer. She was so happy in the pool that she swam around and around.

Time passed by and soon it was time to go home. She got out of the pool and took off her helmet. She smiled and waved goodbye to the pool before she walked home.

The girl was so proud of her swimming skills. Swimming always made her happy. She knew that she wanted to swim again soon!

Max loved football. He saw the other children all playing, so he wanted to join in. He asked his mum and dad for a football, but they said his football was too wide! Max felt sad, he wanted a football to play with. So his dad went to the shop and bought a smaller football that would be easier for him to play with.

Max was so happy, he hugged his dad and thanked him. He couldn't wait to go out and play with the other children. Once outside, Max kicked and dribbled the football, following all the other boys. They played and had fun, and Max felt so relieved he had a football to join in.

No matter what, Max loves playing with his football. Even when he watches his dad and siblings playing football, he likes to sit with his own, wide football and play. He loves running with it, bouncing it and throwing it around. It's one of Max's favourite things to do.

Once there was a little girl named Annabelle. She was very obedient and always listened to her mom. One day her mom asked her if she wanted to go to the movies. Annabelle was very excited and said yes. 

When they arrived at the theatre, Annabelle saw a movie she didn't know before. Her mom asked her if she wanted to watch that movie, but Annabelle refused. She wasn't sure what it was about, and she didn't want to make a mistake. 

Annabelle was very obedient and decided to find another movie they both liked. Finally, they found a nice movie they both knew and liked. Annabelle was very happy and they watched the movie. 

When the movie was over, Annabelle smiled at her mom and thanked her for taking her to the movies. She was so pleased to have been obedient and happy with her decision.

Once there was a little girl called Daisy. Daisy was very brave and loved to explore. One day she saw a tall tower that sparkled in the sun. Daisy thought the tower was very important and wanted to explore it. She took one step forward, but she slipped! Daisy started to cry. 

But then, something wonderful happened. A lovely fairy flew down from the sky and landed beside Daisy. She said, "Don't be scared, Daisy! I'm here to help you explore the tower!" Daisy was so happy and smiled. 

The fairy waved her wand and a special ladder appeared. Daisy climbed the ladder carefully and when she reached the top, she saw the most beautiful sights! She waved goodbye to the fairy and thanked her for her help. Daisy had a wonderful time exploring the tower and she never forgot how important it was.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Mona, who loved to jump. Everywhere she went she would jump, even in her bed! 
One day, Mona went to the playground and found a big dark mixer. She was so excited to see it, she jumped up and down in joy. 
Mona asked her mom if she could play with the big dark mixer, her mom said yes so Mona jumped and hopped to the big dark mixer. 
Mona was so happy, she couldn't contain it. She jumped and hopped around the big dark mixer, enjoying all the fun. 
When it was time to go, Mona said goodbye to the big dark mixer with a big jump. She waved at it and went on her way, happy and smiling.

Once there was an old bird. He lived in the sky and loved to soar high. Every morning he would spread his wings and fly around. He was very alert and always kept his eyes open.

One day while he was soaring he saw a young bird below him. He wondered why he was flying so slowly. He dropped down and asked the young bird why he was not soaring. The young bird told him that he was too scared and that he had never soared before.

The old bird smiled and said, "Do not worry, I will help you." So he taught the young bird how to spread his wings and soar high. The young bird was scared at first, but then he had fun flying with the old bird.

Soon the young bird was flying fast and high like the old bird. They soared together in the sky until they had to go home. From then on the young bird never stopped soaring and the old bird was very proud.

One day, a brave little dove woke up. He had a very special secret mission. He fluttered close to the ground, looking around to make sure there was no danger. Suddenly, he saw something up ahead. It was a tall tree with lots of colorful flowers. The dove had never seen anything so beautiful! He knew he had to find a special place to hide his secret.

The brave dove flew up to the tree and found a perfect spot. It was a hollow between two big branches. He carefully tucked his secret away and covered it with some leaves.

Then, the brave little dove flew off. He was on his way to another adventurous mission. He knew he had to be brave and wise on his journey. The dove was excited to see what else he would find.

Mum and Dad had a surprise for Alice. They wanted to give her a letter. They found a pink envelope and they wrote something special on it. Alice was so excited to see what was inside. She jumped up and down with joy.

Dad handed her the envelope, but he said she couldn't open it yet. Alice was disappointed, but she promised to wait.

Next day, Mum and Dad took Alice to the park. They said she could open the pink envelope now. Inside, Alice found a letter. It said, 'We love you!' Alice was so happy. She smiled and hugged Mum and Dad. She knew that the letter was from them and it meant so much to her.

Alice kept the pink envelope with her letter safe forever. She was so excited every time she read it. She would never forget how wonderful that day was when she opened her pink envelope.

Once there was a wise old bird. He liked to watch the world around him. One day, he noticed a squash in the garden. He had never seen such a thing before! So he got closer to take a look. He noticed a white skin with little green bumps, and a sweet smell. His eyes opened wide. He wanted to try the squash! He pecked at it and ate some of the soft, yellow inside. It was delicious! The wise old bird enjoyed the tasty squash and never forgot it. He was sure he would come back soon to try some more.

Once upon a time there was a little girl who liked to bounce. She could bounce higher than anyone else! 

One day, she saw a yellow pond. She wanted to bounce on the pond so she did. She bounced once, twice, three times and then she heard a splash! 

The little girl had bounced so hard that she fell into the pond! She was scared at first, but she started to laugh. She swam around, splashed and had lots of fun in the yellow pond. 

It was so much fun that she started to bounce in the pond. She bounced once, twice, three times. She was so happy and she even taught the frogs how to bounce!

Once upon a time there was a big boat. The boat was floating on the sea. Suddenly, it started to move towards a big reef. The reef was underwater and made of coral. It was so big and beautiful!

The boat sailed close to the reef. Suddenly a giant fish came out of the reef. It splashed around the boat and everyone on the boat was so excited! Then the fish swam away and the boat kept floating towards the reef.

When the boat was very close, everyone on the boat got ready to jump in the water. They all had their swimming suits on. One by one, they entered the reef. Everyone had so much fun swimming around the coral and exploring the reef.

The sun started to set and it was time to go back to the boat. Everyone said goodbye to the reef and promised to one day come back. Then they all got back on the boat and sailed away.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy. She wanted a special scale just like her mummy had. She looked around the store and saw a shining clear scale. It sparkled and glittered in the sunshine and Lucy wanted it so bad. She asked her mummy for it and together they brought it home. 

Once it was home, Lucy grabbed the scale and hugged it tight. She couldn't wait to use it!  She placed it on the kitchen floor and hopped right on. She looked down to see how heavy she was and was amazed by how clear the scale was - she could see the numbers perfectly. She smiled at her mummy and knew she'd found the best scale ever.

Once there was a little boy named Jack. He was three years old and he liked to explore the world around him. One day while playing in the backyard, Jack found a strange object. It was a vest. He was very curious so he carefully put it on. 

That's when something amazing happened. He noticed he could fly! With his new vest, Jack flew higher and higher in the sky. He flew so high that he met the clouds. They were excited to meet a new flying friend.

Jack had so much fun with the clouds, but eventually he knew it was time to go home. He carefully flew back to the ground and took off his vest. He smiled, delighted to have found such an amazing thing.

Jack knew this vest was special, so he decided to keep it safe in a secret hiding spot. He tucked it away and promised to remain careful with it. Jack was so excited to fly some more in the future!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who loved to tear things. One day she saw an envelope lying on the floor. She thought it was so fun to tear, so with a loud tear, she ripped it open. When she opened it, there were lots of colourful pieces of paper inside. She was so happy, that she started picking up the pieces and tearing them up until they were tiny. She kept tearing all the pieces until she could tear no more. Afterwards she felt all giggly and happy, so she laughed out loud. And they all lived happily ever after!

Once there was an oak tree standing by itself in the middle of a field. It had been there for a long time and it was very proud.

One day, a stupid boy came running up to the oak tree. He wanted to climb the tree, but the tree said no. The boy refused to listen and he started to climb up the tree. 

The boy didn't realize how slippery the bark was and he started to slip. He slipped all the way down to the ground and he felt so embarrassed. He started to cry, and the oak tree felt bad.

The boy looked up at the oak tree and started to regret what he had done. He apologized to the tree and promised never to climb it again. 

The oak tree forgave him and the boy walked away, feeling much happier than before. The oak tree was proud that he had remembered his promise and never regretted it.

Olive was a great monkey. She was very brave and always really happy. One day, Olive wanted to see what the world was like outside of her home. She asked her mom if she could go and explore. Mom knew it would be dangerous, so she asked Olive to trust her. She said it was important to stay safe and to come back home soon. 

Olive knew she could trust her mom, so she jumped out into the world. She found lots of wonderful things! She saw big hills and small rivers. On the way back, Olive remembered to stay close to home so she wouldn't get lost. 

When she arrived, she and her mom were so happy. They celebrated with a big hug and lots of cuddles. Olive learned that when she trusted her mom, lots of great things could happen.

Bob was walking down the street when he noticed his wife. She was carrying a bag and she looked very happy. Bob wanted to say hello, but he was feeling a bit foolish. So he just waved instead. His wife waved back, but then she turned and walked away. Bob felt sad and wondered why she seemed so distant. When he got home, he asked his wife what was wrong. She explained that she was going to the store to buy a party hat. It was their wedding anniversary and she wanted to surprise him with a party. Bob was so happy and felt silly for not realising. From then on, he never tried to be too clever and just enjoyed the moment. He was very glad he noticed his wife.

Once upon a time there was a girl who was very anxious about something. She wanted help but she was not sure where to get it. 

One day she saw some police walking by so she knelt down and asked them for help. The police were kind and asked her what was wrong. She told them all about her worries and they said they could help her. 

The police took her to a special place with lots of friendly people who could help her. They told her that it was ok to be anxious and gave her lots of advice. 

Soon the girl learned how to manage her worries and was no longer anxious. She thanked the police for their kindness and went on her way. 

The end.

One day a nice princess was walking in the forest. She noticed a big tree with lots of shiny apples. She wanted to pick the apples and add them to her basket.

The princess said to the tree, â€œPlease, may I add some of your apples to my basket?â€

The tree said, â€œYes, you may take five apples, but please do not take too many. Itâ€™s important to be nice to the trees!â€

So the princess only added five apples to her basket and thanked the tree. Then she went on her way, feeling nice and happy.

Once upon a time there was a family who wanted something to be reliable. They went on a search throughout the house until they came to the cupboard. Inside the cupboard was something special, it was the most reliable thing in the house. The family was so happy that they decided to give it to someone else who could use it. 

The family gave the cupboard to their neighbor who was also searching for something reliable. The neighbor was so excited that they hugged the family to show their gratitude. The family was glad that they could help out their neighbor and make them happy. 

The cupboard was given a new home where it could be relied on for many, many years. And so the family has a happy ending when their reliable cupboard brought everyone a lot of joy.

Once upon a time there was an old man who was very foolish. One day he was walking in the countryside and he saw a bottle lying on the ground. He picked it up and he understood that it had belonged to someone else. He was so excited that he started jumping up and down.

He ran back to his room and held the bottle close while he examined it. It was sparkling and it was so beautiful that it almost seemed magical. He thought that if he drank from it he would feel happy and powerful. But he was a foolish old man and he could not understand this.

So instead, he took the bottle and put it carefully in a special box. He told everyone that he had found a special magical bottle and he showed it off whenever he could. But no one understood the true power of the bottle and they just laughed at the foolish old man.

The end.

Once there was a little girl named Mary. She was embarrassed when she saw a hive in the nearby field. It was a huge hive and it was filled with bees!

But the bees were not angry. They were quite mild and didn't even buzz around. Even though she was scared, Mary felt that she had to go see it.

So she went to the bee hive and looked inside. It was full of little wax cells, filled with honey! Mary was amazed and she smiled. She was no longer scared, she was happy to have discovered this hive.

But then, something embarrassing happened. Mary accidentally knocked over the hive! All the honey and wax spilled out, making a giant sticky mess.

Mary quickly ran away from the hive, embarrassed that she had made such a big mess. But she would never forget the mild and friendly bees in the hive.

Once upon a time, there was a girl. She was playing in her room when she heard a noise. She stopped and listened. The noise was coming from the next room.

Curious, she opened the door and saw her daddy rubbing a magic lamp. He looked embarrassed. The girl smiled. She wanted to rub the lamp too.

So she reached for the lamp - but, just then, her daddy stopped her. He said it was his special lamp and that she should not touch it. So the girl stepped back, happy and sad at the same time.

The girl and her daddy hugged. Then the girl went back to her room and continued playing. The end.

Once there was a little boy whose name was Bob. Bob wanted to draw a picture. He went to his bedroom and found a black marker, some paper and a red crayon. Bob was excited to try and draw a picture.

Bob took the marker and started to draw a big black circle, then he started to draw lots of smaller black circles around it. He then tried to draw a big black tree with big green leaves and a black bird at the top.

Bob was so proud of his picture, but he was missing something. He had a little bit of red crayon left, so he decided to add a red sun in the top corner. Now the picture was complete!

Bob showed the picture to his mom, who hugged him and said it was beautiful. Bob was so proud of himself because he had tried to draw the picture all by himself.

Once upon a time, there was a family who were going on a big holiday. They were all very excited and couldn't wait to go.

They got ready and packed their luggage. It was all so heavy but they were happy.

Soon, their day finally arrived. They waved goodbye to everyone and drove off to the airport. 

When they arrived, they were given tickets and then they waited. They watched all the people coming and going with lots of luggage too.

Eventually, it was time for their plane to arrive. Everyone was so happy! They went to the plane and it was so fair and shiny. 

They took their special seat and off they went in the plane! It was a fantastic flight, and even their luggage arrived safe and sound. 

The family had a wonderful holiday, and they all lived happily ever after!

Muffy the bunny hopped over to the park. She was so excited to play. As she arrived, she saw a big, powerful wheel. It was so high, she could hardly reach the top.

Muffy hopped around the wheel with her friends, until one of them said "Let's take a spin!". She was a bit scared, but also excited. She hopped into the middle of the wheel and held tight.

The wheel started to spin much faster than Muffy expected. She spun around and around, faster and faster! She was so happy, she squealed with delight.

After what felt like a long time, the wheel stopped spinning. Muffy hopped off the wheel and welcomed her friends to join her for a ride. Everyone spun around together and had a great time.

Once upon a time, there was a little ant who wanted to bake a cake. She gathered some flour and sugar, and she found some eggs from the farmerâ€™s market.

She mixed the ingredients together and put it all in a baking dish. She opened the oven and put the cake inside.

The ant waited and waited, until finally she saw the cake was ready! It looked so good and smelled even better.

The ant took the cake out of the oven and enjoyed a nice big piece. It was so delicious, she ate the whole thing! 

Moral of the story: something good can come out of a tiny bit of effort!

Once upon a time, there was a kind person. This person needed to paint a picture for their friend. But before the person started to paint, they decided to have a snack. They ate a yummy treat to give them energy for the painting. 

The kind person was painting for a very long time. They used the paintbrush to make a beautiful picture of a rainbow. The picture was so colorful it made people smile. 

Finally, the painting was done. The kind person thought the picture was wonderful. Then they ran to show their friend the completed painting. 

The friend was thrilled with the painting. They thanked the kind person and gave them a hug. It was a happy ending to the kind person's painting adventure!

Once there was a girl named Susie. She had long, brown hair, but she didn't believe she was all that special. One day her Mommy told her a secret.

"Susie, do you believe in magic?"

 Susie was surprised. She shook her head and said, "No, I don't believe in magic."

But her Mommy smiled and said, "That's okay, because magic believes in you!" 

Susie felt a tingle in her hair and when she looked, there were little sparkles everywhere! 

With a serious look on her face, Susie asked her Mommy how this was possible.

Her Mommy told her it was because she was special and she just had to believe in herself. That's when Susie realized that even though she had simple brown hair, it was just as magical as anything else in the world!

Wendy was a little girl who liked to imagine. One day she was playing in the garden when suddenly an amazing thing happened. She saw a fairy flying in the sky! Wendy was so excited but the fairy looked very upset.

Wendy called out to the fairy, â€œHello! Whatâ€™s wrong?â€ But the fairy didn't answer. She just kept flying away.

Wendy decided to follow the fairy to see why she was so upset. She ran and ran, but the fairy flew faster and she got too far away.

Finally, Wendy stopped running. She was sad and a bit out of breath so she sat down to rest. As she sat there, she closed her eyes and imagined what could have made the fairy so upset. She imagined that maybe the fairy had lost her way and needed help to find her home.

With a renewed sense of hope, Wendy jumped up and started to search for the fairy. She called out to her but the fairy was nowhere to be seen. Suddenly, in the distance, Wendy saw a shimmering light. She knew it was the fairy flying away and that the fairy had now found her way home. Wendy smiled with relief.

Once upon a time there was a modest little girl named Daisy. Daisy loved to help her mommy do the laundry. She would watch as her mommy put the clothes in the washer, and smiled as she filled up the soap.

After the laundry was done, Daisy and her mommy would hang the clothes up to dry outside in the sunshine. Daisy loved seeing the laundry blow in the breeze, and her mommy smiled with happiness at how helpful Daisy was.

Once the laundry was all hung up, Daisy and her mommy stood back and looked at it proudly. Daisy smiled with delight at how colorful and pretty it looked, and her mommy smiled with pride at her little girl's hard work. Together they hugged and celebrated the most modest, yet special, laundry day ever.

Once there was a boy named Bob. He was not very wealthy, but he was happy. One day Bob was walking in the park and he saw a big, fluffy cloud in the sky. He thought it looked so soft and snugly that he wanted to steal it! So Bob reached up high and tried to grab the cloud. But it was too far away.

Bob was sad and he thought he could never get the cloud. A kindly wealthy man saw Bob and said, "I can help you, Bob." The man pulled a long stick out of his coat and gave it to Bob. He said, "Now you can reach the cloud!"

Bob took the stick and swung it up to the sky. He had never seen anything so beautiful! He grabbed hold of the cloud and held tight. Before the man could say a word, Bob ran off with his stolen cloud.

Bob was so happy! He ran around, laughing and twirling all day with his new cloud close to him. He showed it to his friends, who all thought it was the best cloud ever. And Bob never felt so happy and wealthy.

Once upon a time there was a troubled boy. He didn't have any friends because he was always too sad and quiet.

One day the boy decided he needed to do something. So he took out his spoon and started digging and digging in the ground. 

Then something strange happened. He dug right through the ground and ended up in a secret, underground world! This new world was filled with wonderful things he had never seen before and it made him very happy.

When he wanted to go home he used his spoon to make a hole in ground and climbed out. He had a smile on his face as he walked back to his house.

The boy never forgot his special adventure and he was no longer troubled. He had a secret all of his own that he could tell nobody about. And it made him feel better every time he thought about it.  The end.

Once upon a time, there was a patient bear named Bob. Bob was a very kind bear, always wanting to help his friends. One day, Bob went to sit in his chair waiting for a special surprise. His friends all gathered around, excited for Bob to see what had come for him. 

Suddenly, Bob noticed an envelope on the table. Inside was a license. It was a special license, showing everyone that Bob was a very patient bear. Everyone was so proud of Bob and clapped and cheered for him. 

Bob was so happy to have a license. He sat in his chair to show everyone his new license. Bob was so proud of his new found achievement and enjoyed showing off his license to all his friends. 

The End.

Once upon a time, there was a girl who wanted to climb a mountain. Everyone around her said it would be too hard, and that she should not try. But she was very serious and wanted to give it a try. 

So she began to climb. It was hard work, but she kept going. With each step, the mountain got harder and steeper. But still, she kept trying. 

Finally, she reached the top. There, she found a beautiful view that she had never seen before. She was so proud of herself for trying.

The girl went back home and told everyone what a great adventure she'd had. Everyone was so impressed with her serious attitude and determination. They could see that if you try hard enough, anything is possible.

Once upon a time, there was an animal. He was a large, brown bear. But he was broken. One day, he was walking and carrying a big stick, but he was too heavy. The stick dropped to the ground and made a loud noise. The animal was sad and he started to cry.

But then out of the corner of his eye, he saw a bright, yellow butterfly. He watched as it fluttered around and lit up the sky. Seeing the butterfly made him feel better and he stopped crying. He bent down and picked up the stick. Then, he went on his way.

As the animal went on his way, he saw a broken bird in a tree. He reached up and carefully dropped the stick. Then, he used the stick to help the bird and carefully carried her away until she felt safe.

The animal was happy that he was able to help the bird, but he felt a little sad about his broken stick. He put the stick back where he had found it and smiled as he saw the bright, yellow butterfly flying around again. 

The animal was still broken, but he was content knowing that he had made the world a brighter, and safer, place for one small animal.

Once upon a time there was a boy called Tom. He was young and liked to explore the world around him. Today he decided to go for a walk in the countryside. So he asked his mom if he could go outside and she said yes.

Tom began running and soon found a bush. It was quite big and it looked a bit rough. He wanted to hurry over to the bush and explore it. He ran as fast as he could and made it to the bush in no time. 

Excitedly, Tom started to look around the bush. He found lots of interesting things to see. He found caterpillars and bugs, stones and leaves. But most of all he saw lots of tiny flowers in the bush.

Tom was having great fun, but soon it started getting dark. So he had to hurry back home before it got too late. He ran and ran, but eventually made it back safely. 

And so Tom had a wonderful day, having explored the rough bush and seen lots of exciting things!

Once upon a time, there was a robot. It was fast and strong. It could do a lot of things. One day, the robot went for a walk. It wanted to guess a secret. As it walked, it noticed something interesting. It saw an animal crawling in the grass. "What is that?" the robot wondered. It couldn't tell. It had to guess. So it made a guess. It guessed that the animal was a rabbit. And it was right! The robot was happy. It had guessed the secret.

One day, at the beach, Sam saw something strange. There was a mysterious row in the sand. The row seemed to be increasing, getting longer and longer.

Sam was curious and wanted to find out what it was. He touched the row and realized it was made up of tiny shells. Suddenly, a little crab emerged from the sand and waved its claws at Sam.

Sam was surprised and jumped back. He watched as the crab continued to increase the row of shells. Sam's mom smiled and told him that the crab was building its home.

Then, Sam and his mom watched together as the crab worked and the mysterious row of shells slowly increased in length. Sam smiled and knew he had found a new friend.

Jenny was a happy 3 year old who loved to explore. One day she was in her bedroom and wanted to find out what was on the ceiling. She stood on her tippy toes and looked up. She saw something that made her smile. It was bright and peaceful. It was the sun! The sun was shining through the window onto her ceiling.

The next day, Jenny wanted to show her friends what she had seen. She invited them to come over and take a look. They all looked up and admired the sight. Everyone was in awe of the peaceful, bright sun.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Fiona. Fiona was 3 years old and she liked to run. One day, Fiona went outside with her mom to play. Suddenly Fiona started to run too fast and she tripped over a rock. She hurt her foot really bad and started crying.

Her mom took her quickly to the hospital. She was so scared she curled up in her mom's lap. Once at the hospital, the doctors put Fiona in a big red chair and checked her foot. After lots of tests, the doctors said Fiona had to stay in the hospital for a few days.

Fiona didn't like this plan but mom said that it was ok. She explained that the hospital would make Fiona's foot all better. Fiona was so brave and stayed in the red chair to get bandages. After many days of rest, Fiona was all better and she could run again. She was so happy.

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Cindy. She was very special because she could grow things with her magical spell. Wherever she went she would cast her spell and flowers would grow out of the ground. Even bees and butterflies followed her around! Everyone was so impressed by her magic.

Every day, Cindy would explore and find new places to grow things. She would use her impressive spell and make trees bloom and fruits sprout out of the ground. Birds would then come to eat the fruits that Cindy created. It was very cool! 

One day, Cindy wanted to make something really special. She closed her eyes, held her hands to her chest, and said her magical spell. When she opened her eyes, she couldn't believe what she saw! A big, beautiful castle had appeared out of nowhere. It was so impressive! 

From that day on, Cindy's magical spell was known all over the world. People admired her special talent and she was able to create even more amazing things!

Once there was a fierce bear. He lived in a chimney. The bear thought the chimney was the best place to live. He would climb up there and stay all day.

One night, something very strange happen to the bear. He heard a loud noise coming from outside. He peeked his head out of the chimney to see what it was. It was a bright light that filled the night sky.

The bear was very scared. He quickly climbed back into the chimney and cowered in the shadows. But the sound and light came closer and closer.

Finally, the noise and light ended. The bear felt safe and peered out of the chimney again. He wasn't sure what had happened, but he was glad it was over.

The bear stayed in his chimney for many days, until one day he finally felt brave enough to explore. He looked around and found out that he had been visited by a shooting star!

One day, there was a bird who was very keen to whistle. He wanted to be the best whistler around. So every day, he perched on the rail outside his house and whistled his heart out.

The other birds were very ignorant of the new whistler, but his tunes were so sweet that they soon began to sing along. The Rail was filled with joyful song and it made the Bird happy to hear them all joining in. He kept on whistling and soon more and more birds were joining in.

Each day, more and more birds would come to perch on the Rail and join in the singing. It was a beautiful sight to see and hear. All the birds were so happy.

When the Bird looked around, he noticed that even the ignorant birds were smiling and joining in. This made the Bird very happy and he kept on whistling away until it was time for him to go home. From then on, the birds all kept on whistling away whenever they come to the Rail.

Once there was a baby fox running in the forest. He was so happy; running left and right, zigzagging through the trees. Suddenly, he saw a big bear! The baby fox froze and stopped moving. The bear yawned and looked very sleepy. 

The baby fox was scared, but the bear didn't move at all. After a few minutes, the baby fox slowly started to walk to the side. But then he stopped again, because the bear was still there.

The baby fox wanted to get past the bear, so he had an idea. He started to run around the bear, zigzagging in a big circle. The bear was so sleepy it didn't even notice! The baby fox was so happy that he ran even faster, until he disappeared into the trees.

Once upon a time, there lived a little boy named Sam. Sam was a very happy boy because he liked to explore outside. One day, Sam went to the forest to look for something special. He searched and searched, until he finally found something - a yummy root! He was so excited and he couldn't wait to try the root. 

But when Sam ate the root, his tummy hurt so much that he started to cry. He was so sad. Suddenly, he heard something coming from nearby. It was a gentle voice saying, "Don't cry, Sam". 

Sam looked up, and he saw an old man sitting on a tree stump. He asked the old man what he could do to help his tummy. The old man said that he should eat a banana and that it would make him feel better. 

So Sam ate the banana, and he felt much happier. From then on, whenever he felt sad he would find a yummy root in the forest - and that would always make him feel better.

Once upon a time, there was a pillow. Just like all other pillows, it was soft and fluffy. Every night it would be used by a little girl. She would take it to bed, hug it, and soon fall asleep. 

One night something strange happened. She woke up and saw something that scared her. It was a big, dark cloud standing next to her bed. She screamed and quickly ran to her mom.

Her mom comforted her and said, "Don't worry. It's just a dream. It's not real." Then she picked up the pillow and handed it to the little girl. The girl hugged the pillow with relief and soon felt safe again. She thanked her mom for being so fair. 

The little girl learned that night that sometimes scary things can seem real, but in the end, her mom was always there to take care of her. And the pillow was there to comfort her when she was afraid.

Jill had a microphone. It belonged to her, and she could use it whenever she wanted. She liked talking into it and singing into it. She asked her mom if they could go somewhere special to use the microphone.

Mom said yes, and took her to a regular cafe. At the cafe, there was a band playing. A regular band. They had drums, guitars, and a microphone. Jill's eyes lit up. She pointed to the microphone and said she wanted to use it.

The band said 'yes'. Jill said she wanted to sing a song. Mom counted to three and Jill sang her favorite song. Everyone at the cafe clapped and cheered. Jill felt so proud and happy. She held the microphone and knew it belonged to her. It made her feel special.

Once upon a time there lived a family with a mom, dad, and two kids. One day, the dad was taking the kids for a ride in the family van. The dad drove the van too fast, and he made a mistake! He crashed into another car. The other car was scared and angry, but the dad said he was sorry. He asked the other car to forgive him. The other car was very enthusiastic and said that it would forgive him. 

The family was happy. They talked to the other car and found out it was a nice family. They said they would stay friends. So, they shook hands and the van drove away. The family in the van felt thankful that the other car was so understanding and forgiving. They decided to forgive others when they make mistakes too!
